segments.text: I'm 30, but my skin age is 21, and I reversed it very scientifically. [music] So, go and get a Visia facial scan. Lots of clinics and med spas will have these. You'll be able to see what you're good at and what you're struggling with in your skin. For example, if you've got lots of UV damage, you know that your skin is susceptible to the sun, so you can start protecting against it more, and then watch those numbers come down. Now that you know where you're struggling, you know what interventions [music] you're going to do that are scientifically backed, you can retest in a handful of months and see have you made progress. And it's incredible how big of a difference that's made.
